native_steps: Launched an empty project. The bent swatch with Flat and Metres showed a panel-specific planar mapping error and disabled Import. Posed produced one exterior contour. Import created six vertices and one piece at revision 1.
Undo emptied the document at revision 2. Redo restored the swatch at revision 3. Saved Bent native.weftforge and quit.

Launched a new empty process and used File → Open to reopen Bent native.weftforge. Revision 3 displayed one piece and six vertices. Exported Bent reopened.obj, selected the pattern, framed the 2D view and saved the workspace PNG.

Clear imported pose regenerated the panel with 49 vertices at revision 4. Exported Bent cleared.obj. Undo at revision 5 restored the six-vertex pose and the Clear imported pose control. Exported Bent restored.obj, saved Bent restored.weftforge and quit. The case app was absent from the running application list.
cli_steps: A fresh empty project, import-obj with metres_per_unit 1 and mode posed, and export-obj on the saved file. Each command ran in a new process for the extended swatch and two-panel Harbor.
comparison: Analytic area-uniform scale, unmodified XYZ, original oriented triangles and source color. Reference flat extent differences remain in docs/posed-obj.md. No live reference comparison or solved shirt acceptance.
